iii_generation.generation_argument: Structural shortcut, not exhaustive: F_p^2 is an irreducible F_p[S3]-module under this action (p=691 does not divide |S3|=6, and the standard 2-dim rep of S3 is irreducible for p>3). Any subgroup K <= R0(p) with K surjecting onto S3 has K cap F_p^2 an S3-submodule of F_p^2, hence in {0, F_p^2}. K=R0(p) iff K cap F_p^2 = F_p^2. Since <r,s>=S3 (faithfulness_check above) and x,y project onto r,s, <x,y> surjects onto S3 automatically; the single Size(<x,y>) = |R0(p)| computation above is therefore a decisive (not probabilistic) confirmation that <x,y> cap F_p^2 = F_p^2, i.e. genuine (2,3)-generation of R0(p) -- found on the first of 20 permitted random trials.
